title: Use of AI to Improve Small Local Businesses | Digital Marketing Hacks

facts.fact: The page states that AI-driven data analytics tools offer small local service businesses insights into customer behaviour, preferences, and trends.
facts.quote: AI-driven data analytics tools offer small local service businesses invaluable insights into customer behaviour, preferences, and trends.

facts.fact: The page states that machine learning lets AI analyse data from website interactions, social media engagements, and customer feedback.
facts.quote: Through machine learning algorithms, AI can analyse vast amounts of data collected from various sources, including website interactions, social media engagements, and customer feedback.

facts.fact: The page describes AI-powered content curation tools as scouring the internet for relevant and trending topics within a business's industry to build a steady stream of social media content.
facts.quote: AI-powered content curation tools come to the rescue by scouring the internet for relevant and trending topics within the business’s industry.
